comment: Recorded architecture-boundary debt (stokaro/ptah#1344, ADR 0001 section 8 stage 0). A count may fall and may never rise, and a rule with package counts is compared package by package. Known false positives: shared-packages-name-dialects counts a string that equals a dialect spelling and names something else, since the type checker cannot tell them apart: Liquibase's database short names (internal/liquibaserun). Regenerate with: go run ./internal/cmd/boundaries -update
